title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: after Expand all, groups loaded later arrive expanded
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • More than 30 vendors have overdue bills on today's date.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/P Unpaid Invoices is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the chevron button in the table's top-left header cell until its tooltip reads "Collapse all" (every group expanded).
  2. Scroll down (or go to the next page) until more vendor groups arrive.
  3. Look at the groups that just arrived.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: every group on screen is expanded.
  • Step 2: the next vendors load.
  • Step 3: they arrive expanded, showing their rows, without another click.

How the next 30 vendors are reached (page buttons or scrolling) is question 6.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-R2: “After Expand all, groups that arrive later as the user scrolls also arrive expanded.”
  • S4-R1: “The table's top-left header cell holds one chevron button. While any group is expanded it points down, its tooltip (above the button) reads "Collapse all", and a click collapses every group. When every group is collapsed it points right, its tooltip reads "Expand all", and a click expands every group.”
